svg.title: Figure 5. Plastic bending of a rectangular section (normalized)
svg.desc: Three normalized plots for an elastic–perfectly plastic rectangle. (a) Stress through the depth at curvatures of one, two and eight times the yield curvature: linear in an elastic core and flat at plus or minus the yield stress in outer plastic zones that grow toward the neutral axis. (b) Moment over yield moment versus curvature over yield curvature: linear up to one, then curving toward 1.5, the fully plastic moment; an unloading line from three times the yield curvature has the elastic slope and leaves a permanent curvature. (c) Residual stress after unloading from three times the yield curvature: the loaded stress plus the elastic unloading stress, which leaves tension near the top, compression just inside it, and the reverse below the neutral axis.
